dependencyNotes.sharp: PINNED to the version Next 16 already installs, and declared DELIBERATELY rather than added. It was in the tree transitively (next -> sharp) and loadable, so nothing new is installed by this entry — what was missing was the declaration. Undeclared, a minor Next release dropping or moving it would break §10b's shelf with a module-not-found from a package nobody chose. It decodes cover art to compute a spine colour (src/lib/images/spine-colour.ts); §5.9 accepts jpeg/png/webp and two of the three real covers are PROGRESSIVE jpeg, so hand-rolling a decoder would mean three decoders and a silently wrong colour on the ones it got wrong. Do not remove it as 'a heavy native dependency for one colour computation' — it ships in the Vercel bundle either way.
